subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Caught in a time warp

options.text: To avoid talking about what’s important
To remain unchanged from a time in the past

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. 'To remain unchanged from a time in the past'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Caught in a time warp"** means to remain unchanged from a time in the past; it refers to something or someone that seems to be stuck in a different time period. (समय में फंसा हुआ)

 
 
• **Example:** The old café is caught in a time warp, with décor and music from the 1950s.
 
 
 
• **"To avoid talking about what's important"** means to sidestep or evade addressing the main issue. (महत्वपूर्ण बातों के बारे में बात करने से बचना)
 
 
• **Example:** He kept talking about trivial matters to avoid talking about what's important.
 
 
 
• **"To make extra effort"** means to put in more effort than usual to achieve something. (अधिक प्रयास करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She made extra effort to ensure the project was completed on time.
 
 
 
• **"To be extremely happy"** means to feel a great amount of happiness or joy. (अत्यधिक खुश होना)
 
 
• **Example:** He was extremely happy when he got the news of his promotion.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: To avoid talking about what's important** (महत्वपूर्ण बातों के बारे में बात करने से बचना):

 
 
• **Example:** He changed the subject to avoid talking about what's important.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: To make extra effort** (अधिक प्रयास करना):
 
 
• **Example:** She made extra effort to finish the project before the deadline.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: To be extremely happy** (अत्यधिक खुश होना):
 
 
• **Example:** He was extremely happy when he heard the good news.
